title: 2021 IRC stairways
disclaimer: Hints only, not a compliance certificate. The 2024 IRC renumbered stair provisions and is not used here.

sources.name: 2021 International Residential Code §R311.7
sources.note: Verified against the Stairway Manufacturers' Association visual interpretation, which quotes the 2021 IRC text. The ICC primary page was not machine-readable.

sources.name: ICC 2021 IRC chapter 3
sources.note: Primary publication. Automated access was blocked, so figures were checked against the SMA reproduction rather than the ICC HTML.

widthClear.note: Width ≥ 36 in (914 mm) clear above handrail height. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

widthBelowOneHandrail.note: ≥ 31½ in (787 mm) at and below one handrail. Not used as the stair-width minimum. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

widthBelowTwoHandrails.note: ≥ 27 in (698 mm) at and below two handrails. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

handrailProjectionMax.note: Handrail projection ≤ 4½ in (114 mm) each side. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

headroom.note: Headroom ≥ 6 ft 8 in (2032 mm). Recorded only; the stair object has no measured headroom. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

flightRiseMax.note: Maximum vertical rise of a flight is 12 ft 7 in (3835 mm) between floor levels or landings. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

riserMax.note: Riser ≤ 7¾ in (196 mm). Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

riserVariation.note: Riser variation ≤ ⅜ in (9.5 mm). Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

treadMin.note: Tread depth ≥ 10 in (254 mm). Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

treadVariation.note: Tread variation ≤ ⅜ in (9.5 mm). Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

winderTreadWalkline.note: Winder tread ≥ 10 in at the walkline. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

winderTreadMin.note: Winder tread ≥ 6 in (152 mm) at any point. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

walklineOffset.note: Walkline is 12 in (305 mm) from the inside of the turn. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

nosingMin.note: Nosing ¾ in (19 mm) minimum unless tread ≥ 11 in. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

nosingMax.note: Nosing 1¼ in (32 mm) maximum. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

nosingExemptTread.note: Nosing is not required when tread depth is ≥ 11 in (279 mm). Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

landingTurnMin.note: Landing depth ≥ 36 in (914 mm) in the direction of travel, and landing width ≥ flight width. Turning landings are checked against max(914, flight width). Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

straightLandingMin.note: Straight-run landing depth ≥ 36 in (914 mm). Landing width equals the flight width by construction. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

handrailMinRisers.note: Handrail on at least one side for flights with 4 or more risers. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

handrailMin.note: Handrail height 34 in (864 mm) minimum. Checked only as a reminder. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

handrailHeightMax.note: Handrail height 38 in (965 mm) maximum. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

guardHeight.note: Guard height ≥ 36 in (914 mm). Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

stairGuardMin.note: Open side of stairs ≥ 34 in (864 mm). Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

spiralWidthMin.note: Spiral width ≥ 26 in (660 mm). Spiral kind is not in the v2 stair enum; value is recorded only. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

spiralTreadMin.note: Spiral tread ≥ 6¾ in (171 mm) at the walkline. Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

spiralRiserMax.note: Spiral riser ≤ 9½ in (241 mm). Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.

spiralHeadroom.note: Spiral headroom ≥ 6 ft 6 in (1982 mm). Verified against SMA verbatim reproduction of 2021 IRC text; primary ICC page not machine-readable.
